parsed.report:
DELPHI's validate_generation compared the generated design "wingless-flying-fish" against the base "flying-fish". The desired phenotype was "a flying fish that still glides at least 20 m from a 1 m launch after its pectoral fins are reduced to zebrafish proportions". Only one criterion was parsed: glide_range_total_m >= 20 m at adult, from a 1 m launch, marked hard. One clause was NOT parsed, and the tool says an unparsed requirement is an unchecked requirement. The leftover text was "a that still after its pectoral fins are reduced to proportions". No sequence was assessed: the basis was document-only and 0 loci were covered.

The five results are reported side by side. Each has its own status and gate.

1. genotype_similarity: cannot-assess. The generated design carries no gene-level edit, so there is no edited sequence state to compare with any real orthologue. This is not a pass. No genotype was assessed. The design differs from its base morphologically, and a parameter delta has no allele to score.

2. phenotype_similarity: pass. The design is inside the calibrated shape distribution (body p 1). This is shape similarity to real specimens, not relatedness. It is silent on every feature the comparison does not read.

3. lean_check: cannot-assess. No Lean law could be evaluated on this design: 30 were cannot-evaluate and 5 were out of scope. No accepted-law violation was found, but that is not a pass.

4. functional_resolution: cannot-assess. No differences were classified. The ledger is empty, which is not evidence that there are none.

5. physics_check: fail. The design does not do what was asked. The hard glide criterion was not met. The reachable launch speed of 15.00 m/s is below v_min of 21.75 m/s, so lift cannot carry the weight. The criterion was achieved in 0.0% of 200 draws, with a median of 0 m (5–95% range 0 to 0). Two standing checks also failed, and they are reported beside the gate rather than folded into it. reaches_minimum_flight_speed at adult is 6.75 m/s short. lifting_area_supports_mass at adult has a lifting area of 26.04 cm2 against 54.76 cm2 needed to carry 0.589 N, which is 2.10x too small.

Verdict: the word "validated" is withheld. The reasons are listed in withheld_because. The tool says this report states what was checked and what was not, and is not a validity claim.

Scales not assessed: cell, tissue and organ_system. Per per_scale_coverage, each of these is empty rather than clear.
